unit.why: A single narrative about the Besht's grief over the martyrs of the Pavolitch blood libel and the nighttime visit of the martyrs' souls with R. Akiva.

stories.start_quote: מעשה עלילה דק"ק פאווליטש וברח הרב
stories.summary_en: After the Pavolitch blood libel the Besht detains the fleeing R. David of Korostyshev; when news of the martyrs' torture arrives he mourns all Sabbath eve, lying prostrate. At midnight R. Akiva and the souls of the martyrs appear, refuse his decree that they take revenge on the accuser, and explain why Heaven hid their fate from him. A coda blames a Brody preacher's sermon for the deaths.
